segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Jesus used a picture the crowd knew well — a sheepfold with one opening, and a shepherd who guards it through the night. The opening is where danger is stopped and every sheep is known.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Someone who sneaks over the wall avoids the shepherd because he is there to take, not to care.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: But the door is not another trap or test. It is the guarded way the flock comes in safe.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Through him you come in and you go out — free, fed, not trapped. Notice that the door is a person, not a score you must earn. Safety and pasture begin with trusting the shepherd who put himself in the opening.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The way home is not hidden from you. The Shepherd himself is the door. Knock, and walk through.
